title: Shinonome Ena — A Bag Full Of Care〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know it isn't 25:00 yet...
But I wonder if anyone's already here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hi, Amia. Is it just you here right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup. K's probably still working on her own.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki said she'd join us after she finished her homework. That was about an hour ago, so she might log in soon!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, I guess that means it'll be just the three of us again today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, I wonder if Kanade replied back about the rough draft of my illustration.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, K really hasn't logged on at all since then...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Seems that way.
To be fair, it's not the first time she's done something like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <More importantly, I can't wait to see how the song K's working on turns out♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, she's basing it off of that really warm and cozy memory Mafuyu has of her mom!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Thank you for being friends with Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Mafuyu mentioned a friend who plays music. Is that you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Music...?
No, I'm not sure what you're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I didn't feel a single ounce of warmth when I talked to her on the phone that time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, Amia, when would you say you have warm feelings about your family?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Where's this coming from all of a sudden?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whenever they let me be me, and make it clear that they see me for who I really am, I guess?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, I gave you a proper answer, didn't I?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, it's your turn to answer.
When do you feel that sort of warmth with your family?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah, I remember my chest feeling hot when I told him what I wanted to do in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that's probably altogether a different kind of emotion...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, did you think of a good memory?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <When I threw out my sketchbook, my mom actually took it out of the bin and saved it for me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<That was when I was still in junior high.
She kept it believing that I'd really regret it somewhere down the line...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <When she gave it back to me, I was overcome with this sense of warmth...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You've told me a few times about her already, and she seems like an amazing mom.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, I feel like she really gets who you are as a person, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Maybe it's weird for me to say myself, but she is my mom, after all.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The warmth I felt that time might be similar to the sensation Mafuyu felt from that woman when she was small...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We probably didn't feel exactly the same thing, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I might try asking Yuki more about the warmth she felt when she gets here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's a great idea!
It should help us a lot with our work!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Exactly. I hope she gets here soon.>
